Class FightView

java.lang.Object
views.View<Controller>
views.fight.FightView
public class FightView extends View<Controller>
View for the fight screen.

Displays the battle UI: Bugémon sprites, HP bars, combat messages, action/attack panels, and the player's team grid. Handles mouse hover and click popups on team sprites. All user interactions are forwarded to a FightListener; this view has no direct dependency on any concrete controller.

  • Constructor Details

    • FightView

      public FightView() throws IOException
      Constructs the view by loading the FXML and binding all button actions.

      Note: button handlers reference listener via lambda — the listener must be set with setListener(FightListener) before any button is clicked.

      Throws:
      IOException - if the FXML file cannot be loaded

      public void displayTeam(List<BugemonDTO> team)
